'''Rita''' (Japanese: '''レイコ''' ''Reiko'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG012|The Lotad Lowdown]]''. She is the eldest sister of [[Nicole]] and [[Natalie]]. She is in charge of watering the garden at, and the overall maintenance of the [[Pretty Petal flower shop]].

As Rita entered the shop, she was quite surprised to see {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} visiting them. Rita told her sisters that there was a problem with one of the watering pipes of the garden. After the group finished touring around the garden, Rita told Nicole that she needed to replace the broken watering pipe. While the pipe was being replaced, the {{p|Lotad}} came in to help in watering the garden.

Later, Rita, accompanied by Ash and Brock, went in search of her younger sister, Natalie, who'd ran off in search of a [[Sitrus Berry]] for Brock. After locating her sister, Rita gave her a scolding for running off by herself.

Later, they were captured by {{TRT}} in their [[Team Rocket's mechas|boat]], but with the help of {{AP|Pikachu}} and a powerful Lotad, they were freed, and Team Rocket was sent blasting off.
